scope: 67 selected exact configurations; not an exhaustive catalogue. All 670 component scores sourced, no new model benchmarks. kimi-k3 and nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b were added 2026-09-27 from the same source, for their free NVIDIA routes. claude-haiku-5-5 was added 2026-10-07 from Anthropic's own launch scores (evidence: vendor), with an estimated cost, until Artificial Analysis publishes it. claude-fable-5, claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-5, deepseek-v4-flash, glm-5-2, qwen3-5-397b-a17b, qwen3-6-27b, kimi-k2-6, glm-5-1, gemini-2-5-pro, gemini-3-1-flash-lite-preview, gemini-3-1-pro-preview, gemini-3-6-flash, grok-4-3, grok-4-5, grok-4-6, grok-4-7, kimi-k2-7-code, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-4-mini, gpt-5-4-nano, gpt-5-5, gpt-5-6-luna, gpt-5-6-sol, gpt-5-6-terra, gpt-6-1-sol, qwen3-5-9b, qwen3-7-max, qwen3-7-plus, qwen3-8-2-4t-a95b, deepseek-r1-0120, ministral-3-14b, gpt-oss-20b added 2026-10-07 from Artificial Analysis's model pages. claude-haiku-5-5 sourced from Artificial Analysis from 2026-10-07. claude-haiku-5-5-medium, claude-haiku-5-5-high, claude-haiku-5-5-xhigh, claude-haiku-5-5-low added 2026-10-07 from Artificial Analysis's model pages.
selection_policy: Published task-specific evidence first; choose cheapest capable available Swarm route, escalate for quality or capacity. Desktop Opus 5.5 retains orchestration and final decisions.
cost_note: Measured AA index cost per task, rounded as published; not a prediction of production cost. Token rates are separate, current standard API reference rates.
limitations: AA Index includes CritPt at 10% and CritPt is marked under review.
Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 rows include production fallback as named, so these are deployed configurations rather than isolated weights.
Small score gaps are not reliable universal ordering; the Pareto frontier uses rounded point estimates only.
Different task categories and providers can change the preferred model.
No account access or current quota validation is implied.
